result.rationale: The migration inserts embeddable_hosts lines raw via SQL (`INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`), and the old setting explicitly allowed entries like 'http://discourse.org' or 'https://example.com/1234' (per removed site_setting.rb logic and the old spec `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts = "#{host}\nhttp://discourse.org\nhttps://example.com/1234"`). The new lookup `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` compares `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, so stored values containing scheme/path never match, silently breaking embeds for migrated hosts. Verified from the diff.

judged_text: db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:25 — The migration copies raw `embeddable_hosts` lines verbatim (`VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) bypassing the model's scheme/path normalization, but the old `allows_embeddable_host?` accepted entries like `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234` via `URI(h).host`, so after upgrade those stored values never equal `uri.host` in `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` and previously working embeds break (P1, conf 75)
